definitions.explanation: The age range from 40 to 49 years old. Used to describe a person's approximate age or to refer to this demographic group as a whole. In Japan this is often regarded as the period of peak responsibility at work and in the household.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四十代|よんじゅうだい}だ。
examples.english: My mother is in her forties.

examples.japanese: {四十代|よんじゅうだい}になって⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衰|おとろ}え→衰え：20068_otoroe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じ→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Now that I'm in my forties, I've started to feel my stamina declining.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四十代|よんじゅうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ターゲット→ターゲット：11036_taagetto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This product was developed with women in their forties as the target market.

examples.japanese: {四十代|よんじゅうだい}⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一段落|いちだんらく}→一段落：15685_ichidanraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Once people reach their late forties, many find that the busiest phase of raising children has passed.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{四十|よんじゅう}→四十：01009_yonjuu⟧ ('forty') + ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ ('generation; age bracket'). Follows the standard decade pattern: ⟦{二十代|にじゅうだい}→二十代：20477_nijuudai⟧, ⟦{三十代|さんじゅうだい}→三十代：16596_sanjuudai⟧, {四十代|よんじゅうだい}, ⟦{五十代|ごじゅうだい}→五十代：25926_gojuudai⟧, etc. The reading is always よんじゅうだい — not しじゅうだい, because {四|し} is avoided as a homonym of ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ ('death') in age expressions.

SUBDIVISIONS:
- {四十代|よんじゅうだい}⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧: early forties (40-44)
- {四十代|よんじゅうだい}⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧: mid-forties (around 45)
- {四十代|よんじゅうだい}⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧: late forties (46-49)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四十代|よんじゅうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧/⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: man/woman in their forties
- {四十代|よんじゅうだい}{向|む}け: aimed at people in their forties
- {四十代|よんじゅうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn forty (enter one's forties)
- {四十代|よんじゅうだい}のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: while still in one's forties
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り→働き盛り：28201_hatarakizakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{四十代|よんじゅうだい}: people in their prime working years in their forties

USAGE:
- Very common in marketing, health articles, and demographic commentary. The forties are culturally seen as ⟦{働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り→働き盛り：28201_hatarakizakari⟧ ('prime working years'), often with peak responsibilities at work and at home.
- In older literature, {四十路|よそじ} is a poetic alternative, but {四十代|よんじゅうだい} is the standard modern term in speech, print, and statistics.
- Unlike {四十歳|よんじゅっさい} ('forty years old'), {四十代|よんじゅうだい} refers to the entire decade rather than a specific age.
